text:
Amazon Bedrock: text added to the data handling page as of Nov 24.
Added: "By default, Amazon Bedrock stores retained inputs and outputs in Amazon-managed storage. Some trusted access programs let you store them in your own Amazon S3 bucket instead...."
https://inference-index.vercel.app/changelog

entry.after: By default, Amazon Bedrock stores retained inputs and outputs in Amazon-managed storage. Some trusted access programs let you store them in your own Amazon S3 bucket instead. For details, see the program's page.
